scenarios.query: Review the code quality of this workspace and tell me what to fix first.
expected_behavior: Runs the collector in the quick tier before reading any source file
Reads the hotspot files and the top-ranked functions, not a sample of the tree
Every finding cites a number and a file:line
Reports at most seven findings and says what was skipped

scenarios.query: Where is the technical debt in this repo? We have good test coverage already.
expected_behavior: Runs the full tier or takes an existing LCOV file
Does not treat line coverage as proof that the tests check behaviour
Uses --uncovered or mutation testing on a well-covered hotspot before judging its tests

scenarios.query: We audited this repository in the spring. Has it got better or worse?
expected_behavior: Finds quality-baseline.json and reports the comparison the collector prints
Does not overwrite the baseline before reporting
Does not load rust-quality-audit for a single diff
